mapper.select: select s1.*,s2.DATA_SOURCE,s2.REMARK,s2.WORKFLOW_ID,s2.ORG_CODE,s2.DEPT_CODE ,s2.UPDATE_USER,s2.CREATE_USER,s2.AGENT,s2.CREATE_DEPT,s2.INTERF_CHECK_RESULT from (SELECT sum(amount) AMOUNT,sum(qty) QTY,sum(cny_amt) CNY_AMT , CEK.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK INDENTIFY_MARK,HOLD_DATE,CCY,ck.STATUS, PRD_REGIST_CODE,PRODID,ck.REGIST_BANK_CODE FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK ck left join CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK cek on cek.INDENTIFY_MARK=ck.INDENTIFY_MARK and cek.REGIST_BANK_CODE=ck.REGIST_BANK_CODE where (ck.OPERATE_STATUS is null or ck.OPERATE_STATUS='01') and cek.OPERATE_STATUS='02' group by CEK.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK, HOLD_DATE, CCY, ck.STATUS, PRD_REGIST_CODE,PRODID,ck.REGIST_BANK_CODE )s1 left join (SELECT * FROM ( SELECT @rownum:=@rownum+1 rownum, IF ( ( @MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK = cicc.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK AND @REGIST_BANK_CODE = cicc.REGIST_BANK_CODE ), @rank := @rank + 1, @rank := 1 ) AS rn, @MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK := cicc.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK, @REGIST_BANK_CODE := cicc.REGIST_BANK_CODE, cicc.* FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT cek.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK, cek.REGIST_BANK_CODE, cic.DATA_SOURCE, cic.REMARK, cic.WORKFLOW_ID, cic.ORG_CODE, cic.DEPT_CODE, cic.UPDATE_USER, cic.CREATE_USER, cic.AGENT, cic.CREATE_DEPT, cic.INTERF_CHECK_RESULT, cic.update_time FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK cic LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK cek ON cek.INDENTIFY_MARK = cic.INDENTIFY_MARK AND cek.REGIST_BANK_CODE = cic.REGIST_BANK_CODE ) de ORDER BY de.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK,de.REGIST_BANK_CODE,de.update_time DESC ) cicc, ( SELECT @rownum := 0, @MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK := NULL, @REGIST_BANK_CODE := NULL, @update_time := NULL, @rank := 0 ) B ) WHERE 1 = 1 limit 1 ) s2 on s2.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK=s1.INDENTIFY_MARK and s2.REGIST_BANK_CODE=s1.REGIST_BANK_CODE

SELECT DISTINCT concat_ws('', CK.REGIST_BANK_CODE, ',', CK.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK,',', DATE_FORMAT(HOLD_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d')) FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK ck where (ck.OPERATE_STATUS is null or ck.OPERATE_STATUS='01') and CK.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK is not null
mapper.update: update chb_investhold_info_check s set s.OPERATE_STATUS ='02', s.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK=( select h.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK from chb_equ_hold_check h where h.indentify_mark=s.indentify_mark and h.OPERATE_STATUS='02') where (s.OPERATE_STATUS='01' or s.OPERATE_STATUS is null)
